title: Hospital Readmission (MIMIC-IV)
summary: TF-IDF baseline misses its AUROC target (0.54), leading to the step 4 pivot to frozen PubMedBERT (0.81), artifact archival, failure on pediatric notes, and future research questions.

title: AlphaFold 2 Discovery (CASP14) ⭐
summary: AlphaFold 1 stalls at GDT_TS 61.2 on T1024 (triggering a Surprise), leading to the step 4 pivot to end-to-end Evoformer + IPA, commit b8e104f, orphan target evaluation, and domain caveats.
